svg.text: Valence-shell configurations across the periodic table
Group headings give the outer configuration: s block ns1-2; p block ns2 np1-6;
d block (n-1)d1-10 ns2 (written d1s2 ... d10s2); f block (n-2)f1-14 (n-1)d0-1 ns2.
* exceptions: Cr and Mo are (n-1)d5 ns1; Cu, Ag and Au are (n-1)d10 ns1.
Original diagram for this lesson; the textbook's picture is not reproduced.
